summary.en: Compare four nonrelational models and reason about partition tradeoffs without treating CAP as a product label.
summary.bn: চার ধরনের NoSQL মডেল তুলনা করো আর network partition হলে কোন সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে হয় বোঝো।

notes: No external NoSQL service is required; examples are data-model and failure-scenario analyses.

sections.title: Choose a boundary and test a failure
Choose a model and its guarantees together

practice.title: Select an aggregate
practice.statementHtml: An application usually reads one order with ten items. What document boundary could fit, and what invariant remains outside it?
hints: Distinguish one-order data from shared inventory.
practice.answerHtml: An order document with an embedded items array can fit the read pattern and preserve agreed prices. Global product stock may still live elsewhere, so order creation and inventory deduction require a defined transaction or reservation workflow. Embedding does not by itself prevent overselling.

practice.title: Explain a partition decision
practice.statementHtml: Two replicas are separated. A write finishes at A, then a read reaches B. What CAP tradeoff appears?
hints: Use the read’s real-time order after the completed write.
practice.answerHtml: B cannot obtain the write from A. Returning its older value can violate linearizable consistency; refusing or waiting sacrifices availability for that request. The theorem describes the partition case, not a universal product label.

practice.title: Distinguish two columns
practice.statementHtml: How does a wide-column store differ from an analytical columnar database?
hints: The shared name does not imply the same access path.
practice.answerHtml: A wide-column design groups distributed rows by partition and clustering keys for specific access patterns. Analytical columnar storage organises and compresses columns to support large scans and aggregates. The terms describe different organisation and workload choices.

practice.title: Choose for transcripts
practice.statementHtml: Why might the existing relational university schema remain preferable for authoritative marks?
hints: List the correctness rules before selecting storage.
practice.answerHtml: It naturally expresses composite result identity, enrollment references, mark checks and joins for reports. A NoSQL alternative may work, but must supply equivalent invariant enforcement and recovery guarantees. Choose from requirements rather than a claim that one family always scales better.

quiz.prompt: Which model groups nested objects into one retrievable aggregate?
quiz.explanation: Documents can embed arrays and nested records.

quiz.prompt: What does a basic key-value lookup require from the caller?
quiz.explanation: The main access route is a known key.

quiz.prompt: What can an oversized wide-column partition cause?
quiz.explanation: Partition design affects both size and traffic concentration.

quiz.prompt: Which workload most directly suggests graph-oriented operations?
In CAP, what consistency notion is commonly used?
quiz.explanation: CAP concerns a real-time-respecting single-copy behaviour.

quiz.prompt: When does CAP’s central tradeoff become unavoidable?
options: Whenever a table has two columns
Only when SQL syntax is used
quiz.explanation: Separated nodes cannot always provide both linearizable results and availability.

quiz.prompt: Does eventual convergence guarantee every read is current?
quiz.explanation: Convergence and immediate visibility are different guarantees.
Applications still depend on field shapes, validation and versions.

quiz.prompt: Why keep an agreed item price inside historical order data?
options: Every duplicated value is always wrong
The price is a network address
Later catalogue changes must not alter the purchase fact
quiz.explanation: Historical snapshots can be intentional denormalisation.

quiz.prompt: Can a relational system and a key-value cache be used together?
quiz.explanation: Complementary models are possible, with extra synchronisation and operational costs.

keyPoints.en: Document stores group nested facts around an aggregate.
keyPoints.bn: Document store-এ সম্পর্কিত ডেটা একটি nested document-এ রাখা যায়।

keyPoints.en: Key-value access works best when the application knows the key.
keyPoints.bn: অ্যাপ্লিকেশন কি জানলে key-value store থেকে ডেটা খোঁজা সহজ হয়।

keyPoints.en: Wide-column design follows partition keys and expected query patterns.
keyPoints.bn: Wide-column ডিজাইনে partition key আর দরকারি কোয়েরি আগে ঠিক করো।

keyPoints.en: During a partition, CAP forces a tradeoff between linearizable consistency and availability.
keyPoints.bn: Network partition চললে CAP অনুযায়ী একই সঙ্গে সব request-এর উত্তর আর এক কপির মতো consistency নিশ্চিত করা যায় না।

keyPoints.en: NoSQL systems still require schemas, invariants and recovery decisions.
keyPoints.bn: NoSQL নিলেও schema, নিয়ম আর recovery plan ঠিক করতে হয়।
